$Comment: What clearing the Turkey Graveyard pays each player there at the end, beside the Great Turkey's own
Claims: the dungeon's Rewards (Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.json) roll it into the chest where
the Great Turkey fell, full the first clear each day and half on later ones: every quantity halves, a
leftover half paying by chance. Every roll here always pays: Harvest Coins and festival tokens through
the Currency reward kind, then Spices for Martha's dishes, Count to CountMax an even pick.
Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear.json adds Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. A companion mod
adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear
